_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro:
Iraga Pemain {player_id} ring Tic Tac Toe.
Tujuan iraga menang tiga baris (ngatep, ngulon, utawi diagonal) ring papan.
Ri tatkala giliran iraga, iraga patut milih nomor kotak (0-8) sané iraga lakar wewehin tanda iraga salanturné.
Contohnya, '[4]' ngewewehin tanda iraga ring sel tengah papan.
Sakadi Pemain {player_id}, iraga dados '{symbol}', yén lawan iraga dados '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Pamargin sané kasurat nénten anut ring format sané patut.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} nenten dados sel sane patut. Patut riantara 0 miwah 8.

game_action.placed: Pemain {player_id} menaruh simbol mereka ({symbol}) di sel {cell}.
